title: fix(app-shell): Pending changes field rows lead with the label; injected hidden columns are not listed (objectui#13125)
body:
Fixes #13125

Clause-②: no

## What changes

The Studio **Pending changes** sheet (`DraftChangesPanel`), in the drill-in under an item row:

- **Field rows lead with the field's label.** An added field now reads `+ Visit Date` with the machine name `visit_date` beside it in monospace, the way the item row already reads (#11862). Changed and removed rows read the same way. Added and changed rows show the label of the draft definition (what publishing installs); a removed row shows the published one's. A field with no label, or with a label equal to its name, reads as its name alone in monospace, exactly as before. The label is read the way the spec declares a field label, as a string: anything else, or a blank one, is no label.
- **`__search` is no longer listed as an author change.** A field row is dropped when every definition of that field in the two bodies carries `system: true` and `hidden: true`. That is the Data pillar's existing rule, `isStudioHiddenSystemField` (#11780), imported rather than restated: no second list of internal names.

Why `__search` appeared at all: the `/meta` read exits serve an object with the platform's materialization seam replayed onto it (objectstack metadata-protocol `materializeFromRegistry`, which calls the registry's `materializeServedObjectOnto`: injected system columns, the search companion, the title designation). The draft read is one of those exits. A NEW object has no published body, so every stamped column read as added.

Where the rows' data comes from (measured before choosing): the drill-in (`EntryDetail`) already reads both item bodies on expand, and `computeChangeDetail` diffs them. The labels and the two marks are read off those same two bodies, so there is no new fetch. `computeChangeDetail` now also returns `fields.labels`, a Map from each listed field to its label (a Map because `__proto__` is a legal field name).

### Row selector for the browser reading

Each field row is now `[data-testid="draft-entry-detail"] [data-testid="draft-field-row"]`: a `p` whose own text is the mark and the label, with the machine name in the `span.font-mono` inside it. The "Also changed:" key rows and the item row are unchanged.

## Scope

- The changed and removed field rows get the same label-first row and the same filter as the added rows. The card's Expected says "Field rows lead with the field label" while the claim names the added-fields rows; it is the same component, the same defect class and one row helper, so the drill-in stays consistent. Declared here so the seat can judge it.
- Not touched: the summary line (#13147), the field pickers (#13152), the "Also changed:" key rows, the item row. No package export, prop or i18n key is added.

## Behaviour change worth naming

An UPDATE whose two bodies differ only in a column the rule hides now reads "No differences detected" once expanded, and drops its Update badge. The no-change mark (#11807) reads the same filtered diff, as it already reads the envelope-free pair (#12594).

## Acceptance notes

- **Audit columns and `owner_id` are still listed on a NEW object** (`created_at`, `created_by`, `updated_at`, `updated_by`, `owner_id`). The platform injects them with `system: true` but without `hidden: true` (`AUDIT_FIELD_DEFS`, `OWNER_FIELD_DEF`), so the existing rule keeps them, and this PR does not widen that rule (dispatch instruction). They now read by label, for example `+ Created At` beside `created_at`. Whether "injected but not hidden" counts as an author change in this sheet is a product decision, not this card's. Carrier: the dispatching seat (`domain:ui` seat 3).
- Seen while testing, not fixed here: a field literally named `__proto__` never reaches the field diff, because `diffFields` (metadata-admin `object-fields-io`) collects its `byName` in a plain object. The spec's field-name grammar admits that name. No public-door reproduction was taken, so no card. Carrier: none.

## Tests

New: `packages/app-shell/src/preview/__tests__/DraftChangesPanel.fieldRows-13125.test.tsx` (11 tests). Its fixtures copy the platform literals the #11780 pin copies (`provisionSearchCompanion`, `OWNING_BUSINESS_UNIT_FIELD_DEF`, the `created_at` row of `AUDIT_FIELD_DEFS`), with that pin's three controls: `internal_note` (hidden, not system: listed), `owner_id` (system, not hidden: listed), `created_at` (audit column: listed).

Ablations, one per changed behaviour. The fix was committed first (`7ed0889`); each mutation went through objectstack's `scripts/ablation-replace.mjs` in wrap mode, which proved the anchor hit once and the blob changed, and proved the restore (blob equal to HEAD, `git diff HEAD` empty):

1. The hidden-column filter replaced by `return true;`: 4 failed, 7 passed. The four hidden-column assertions went red; the "marks one body lacks" control stayed green, as it should.
2. The label lead replaced by `const lead = undefined`: 3 failed, 8 passed. The three render assertions went red; the pure label tests stayed green (they read `computeChangeDetail`, not the row).

Local runs on head `e1ac777`, exit codes captured before any pipe:

- `pnpm exec vitest run packages/app-shell/src/preview/`: exit 0, 29 files, 211 tests passed.
- `pnpm exec vitest run` on four Studio files that render the real panel or pin the rule (`StudioDesignSurface.publishPosture-12517`, `StudioDesignSurface.publishCount-11807`, `DataPillar.hiddenSystemFields-11780`, `DraftPreviewBar`): exit 0, 4 files, 25 tests passed.
- `pnpm --filter @object-ui/app-shell type-check` (`tsc --noEmit && tsc -p tsconfig.test.json`; the test project includes `src/**/*.test.tsx`): exit 0.
- `node scripts/check-changeset-presence.mjs`: exit 0.
- `pnpm check:new-line-citations`: exit 0, 0 new citations.
- `pnpm check:control-bytes`: exit 0.

No test outside `packages/app-shell/src/preview/` expands the drill-in: a `git grep` for `draft-entry-detail`, `draft-entry-toggle` or `computeChangeDetail` over every package's tests hits 10 files, all in that directory. Repo-wide lint and the full test farm are CI's.
